content.short: Streaming payments, payroll and card ecosystem.
content.description: Zebec Network is a multi-chain payments protocol best known for real-time 'streaming' payroll, where employers continuously stream wages to workers instead of paying in fixed cycles. Around this core, Zebec has built an ecosystem for crypto payments, stablecoin payroll, and multi-chain debit cards that let recipients spend earnings in everyday life. Originally launched on Solana, which remains a core deployment, Zebec has expanded across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, and Base, and operates its own payments-focused chain infrastructure for high-throughput transactions. Serving both businesses and consumers globally, Zebec targets companies and DAOs that want programmable, continuous payments and workers who want faster access to their pay, using stablecoins and cards to bridge on-chain payroll with real-world spending.
